descriptionHtml:
ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5050 OC Edition 8GB GDDR7 Gaming Graphics Card

Upgrade your desktop PC setup with the latest cutting-edge graphic technology inside the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5050 OC Edition 8GB GDDR7 graphics card. Available at Turbo Computer, this powerful PC hardware component peripheral is masterfully engineered for competitive 1080p esports players, budget-conscious AAA gamers, and entry-tier content creators across Egypt who demand high-efficiency AI frame generation, advanced ray tracing performance, and superb thermal management. Built with automated Auto-Extreme technology manufacturing and protected by a rigid protective backplate, this GPU guarantees long-term operational sustainability and hardware stability.

The ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5050 OC Edition features 8GB of the newest high-speed GDDR7 video memory running on a 128-bit bus interface layout, fully utilizing the ultra-fast PCIe 5.0 expansion standard. Cooling is driven by dual advanced Axial-tech fans featuring a smaller hub that facilitates longer blades and a barrier ring to increase downward air pressure into the dense 2.5-slot heatsink array. To eliminate unnecessary sound tracking, the integrated 0dB technology safely halts the fans completely during light corporate multitasking or low-temperature operation. With factory-tweaked core clocks out of the box, users can easily monitor and customize performance translations using the official ASUS GPU Tweak III software utility matrix.
